name: Stale Lease Recovery and Single Flight
summary: Recover proven stale, effect-free graph work through targeted lifecycle transitions and coalesce equivalent live attempts without suppressing future natural work.
problem: Dead parent runs can consume durable concurrency indefinitely, while time-bucket idempotency permits overlapping equivalent monitor jobs.
coreOutcomes: Attempt and lease truth separated from raw parent status
Effect-aware targeted recovery with intact event history
Equivalence keys for live single-flight admission
requirements: Canonical run, attempt, lease, effect and receipt records
boundaries: Expired time alone does not prove a side effect is absent
Passive discovery does not mutate history
Live or effect-ambiguous work cannot be terminalised blindly
Historical acceptance does not prove current runtime health
